title: Nutty Snappy Vietnamese Tempeh Skewers
description: Fatty and snappy Vietnamese dish featuring tempeh, with a dairy-free friendly twist, made in a kadhai vessel.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a kadhai vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the tempeh pieces and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, and grated ginger.
Pour the sauce over the tempeh and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped peanuts and cook for 1 minute.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Thread the tempeh pieces onto skewers and drizzle with the melted chocolate.
Garnish with additional chopped peanuts if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
